changesets.name: native-live-resume.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/effect-contract": minor
"@shivaedev/effect-react": minor
---

### Added

- `bind` accepts an optional `resume: ResumeSource` to reopen and reconcile automatic live subscriptions from application lifecycle events alongside the browser defaults. Registry disposal unsubscribes the source.
- React automatic session subscriptions use the same source supplied to `bind` in `SessionBoundary.connect`, so native shells can reconcile live query screens from their own lifecycle events.

changesets.name: owned-versioned-writes.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/effect-sql": minor
---

### Added

- Versioned repositories accept composite keys so a consumer app can keep ownership and version predicates in one atomic write. `OptimisticConcurrencyError.reason` distinguishes `missing` from `stale` under the full key without exposing stored row data.
- Versioned repositories with `conflictColumns` support `insertOrIgnore`, initializing the version to zero while leaving conflicting rows untouched. Unconditional upserts remain unavailable.

changesets.name: screen-optional-pending.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/test-story": minor
---

### Added

- Screen drivers can act on and read screens without a `pending` option. Only `settle()` requires the signal; without it, settlement fails immediately with the typed `MissingScreenPending` error. Drivers that supply `pending` keep `settle()` typed as `Effect<void>`.

changesets.name: session-key-identity.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/platform": minor
---

### Added

- Resolve session-scoped contract subscriptions and command invalidations from request-local `Identity.id`, isolating accounts while notifying other sessions of the same account. Authenticated identity, profile, provider-account and role middleware preserve commit-bound publication and key deduplication.

### Breaking

- Hosted contracts must supply application handlers with `Api.application.toLayer(...)` and leave `$changes` to `appHost`. Custom `$changes` handlers must accept generated query references, call `resolveChanges(rpc, queries)` from `@shivaedev/platform/server/rpc-server/sessionKeys.ts` inside the authenticated stream invocation, and pass both `keys` and `context` to `changes.stream`. Do not accept client-supplied physical keys or scope, or resolve identity while constructing a shared Layer.
- Tracing publishes only unscoped command invalidations. Custom authentication middleware for session-scoped contracts must wrap the invocation with `sessionCommandChanges(effect, rpc, payload)` from `@shivaedev/platform/server/commandChanges.ts` inside its request-local `Identity` provider. Platform's authenticated identity, profile and role middleware do this automatically. Explicit transaction invalidations must use `invalidationKeys(keys, { scope: identity.id })` to share the same scope and deduplication.

changesets.name: sql-update-missing.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/effect-sql": minor
---

### Added

- Unversioned repositories accept `update(input, { onMissing: "fail" })` to return a typed `NoSuchElementError` when no row matches a single-column or composite key. Updates still decode the returned row and announce changes only after commit; missing rows announce nothing. Calls without the option retain their missing-row defect, and versioned repositories retain their typed optimistic concurrency failures.
